commit_message: Expose ADR0127 Sprite Animation to Project Rust
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Extends the existing ABI v3 Project Rust Animation command family on current-main v5 with stable-AssetId SpriteAnimator2D play/pause/stop/clip selection and a copied deterministic Sprite Animation state view. No parallel gameplay API or process-local asset handles cross the boundary.
